description: MainActivity class for an Android app that manages a chat interface, handles broadcast messages, and controls a responder service.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity managing chat UI and broadcast communication.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, registers broadcast receiver, and starts responder service.

methods.name: startResponderService
methods.description: Starts the ResponderService with specified action.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers broadcast receiver, clears chat history, and requests conversation.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming intent messages and updates chat history view.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, stops service if selected.
